name: Ahmad Iskandar
bio:
Ahmad Iskandar's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a childhood fascination with Formula 1 races broadcast on late-night television. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering, he started as a junior engineer with a local racing team, quickly demonstrating a keen eye for detail and a knack for problem-solving. His ability to analyze complex data and make informed decisions led to a promotion to team manager within a few years.

At Reiza Racing Academy, Ahmad focuses on optimizing the team's performance by ensuring seamless coordination between technical staff and drivers. His methodical approach and calm demeanor under pressure make him a valuable asset, particularly during high-stakes races. Ahmad believes in empowering his team and fostering a culture of continuous improvement, always seeking marginal gains that can make the difference between winning and losing. He is known for his meticulous planning and unwavering commitment to excellence.

physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Prefers to drink green tea throughout the day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
